cases.name: Local assets and fonts load; no external runtime requests

viewportMatrix.screenshotPackaging: Screenshots were generated and reviewed during development, but are not bundled. The image names are evidence identifiers, not archive paths.
viewportMatrix.manualReview: All six requested viewport sizes were inspected across visual rounds; affected frames were rechecked after corrections. Seven native 1536×1024 final captures were also inspected.

initialExactPngAssertion.disposition: Investigated, not treated as a scene-state defect. The stricter whole-PNG assertion failed on a single DOM progress-rail pixel.

comparisons.note: Only one pixel on the DOM progress rail differs; no 3D image difference.

reverseTraversal.limitation: Byte identity was evaluated in quiet mode at selected stable phases; living motion is intentionally time-dependent.

finalInteractionChecks.name: 3D range Home and End change the cutaway; focus outline clears its labels
Explicit high query overrides saved low preference
Native wheel drives the coordinated scroll and reverse wheel returns toward start

lifecycle.qualification: One renderer-reported texture remained on departure; this is not a proof that every GPU allocation reached zero. No long memory soak was run.

performance.method: Single browser, 1440×900, approximately 5 seconds per stable scene, SwiftShader; submitted frames and synchronous CPU submission samples collected over that window.

samples.note: Single test browser, SwiftShader software GPU; CPU submission cost and submitted-frame rate are not hardware presentation FPS.

performance.assessment: Light rendering reduced Distribution triangles from 123602 to 41522. Measured software-renderer throughput was about 7–13 submitted frames/s. No 30/60 FPS hardware budget has been verified. CPU submission time is not completed GPU time.
